action_boundary.rationale: Visible-prefix initialization at 2023-03-05T15:18:00+00:00; nearby selection. Report gaps subtract 6.085 s and are projected to the ego's completed-lap boundary, not synchronized measurements. Tyre age/compound retain prefix values. Base pace = prefix-median forecast minus assumed next-lap tyre contribution; not identified vehicle pace. Missing values remain null. All selected cars are ASSUMED ACTIVE; activity is unknown. Historical pit count=0 and used_compounds=current compound are explicit counter assumptions, not observed history. Conditions, curves, physics, future opponent stay-out and scenarios remain manual hypotheses. Inventory stays unknown/unlimited; no stock feasibility claim.
